name: 56096 · Waterville, MN
findings: ZIP 56096 (Waterville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56096 (Waterville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56096 (Waterville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
